vierwaldst-ttersee-axen-schwyz-balcony.title: Vierwaldstättersee · Axen · Schwyz Balcony
vierwaldst-ttersee-axen-schwyz-balcony.slogan: Lake walls, tunnels and a scenic route that demands attention.
vierwaldst-ttersee-axen-schwyz-balcony.story: Lake walls, tunnels and a scenic route that demands attention. A 108 km loop that starts and ends near Luzern, about 2 h 05 of riding. The stops in between: Brunnen water stop, Axenstrasse cliff road and Schwyz. The climb of the day is Sattel  passlet. It is a high-mountain day.

sections.advice: Lucerne lakefront gate → Brunnen water stop is the reward section in Schwyz food. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

This Brunnen water stop → Axenstrasse cliff road stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

scenicChapters.title: Lake Lucerne Axenstrasse
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 40 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Lake Lucerne Axenstrasse
scenicChapters.narrative: For 12 km this is Lake Lucerne Axenstrasse, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
